name: @pipeworx/mcp-wayback

tools.name: get_snapshot
tools.description: Look up the archived/historical version of a web page in the Internet Archive Wayback Machine. Returns the closest available snapshot (its Wayback URL, timestamp and HTTP status). Pass a timestamp to find the snapshot nearest a specific date; omit it to get the latest archived version.

url.description: The page URL to look up, e.g. "example.com" or "https://example.com/page".

timestamp.description: Optional target date as YYYYMMDD or YYYYMMDDhhmmss. The closest snapshot to this time is returned. Defaults to the latest snapshot.

tools.name: list_snapshots
tools.description: List the captured snapshots of a URL in the Internet Archive Wayback Machine over time, using the CDX index. Each entry includes the capture timestamp, the original URL, HTTP status code, MIME type, content digest and a direct Wayback snapshot URL. Optionally restrict to a date range with from/to (YYYYMMDD).

url.description: The page URL to list archived snapshots for, e.g. "example.com".

limit.description: Maximum number of snapshots to return (default 50, max 1000).

from.description: Optional start of date range as YYYYMMDD.

to.description: Optional end of date range as YYYYMMDD.

tools.name: get_capture_count
tools.description: Count how many times a URL has been captured by the Internet Archive Wayback Machine, and find when a URL was first and last archived. Returns the total number of captures plus the earliest and latest capture timestamps (YYYYMMDDhhmmss).

url.description: The page URL to count archived captures for, e.g. "example.com".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-wayback forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the wayback pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
